intg.intro: The API keys of the email, payment and delivery services installed in this shop.
intg.inactive.title: Saved keys stay off until activated
intg.inactive.body: A key you save here is stored encrypted. Mail can use it only after it is activated, and only when the server is not already choosing the email provider. This screen does not activate it. Payment and delivery still use the keys set on the server.
intg.storageDisabled.title: Keys cannot be saved on this server
intg.storageDisabled.body: The server has no encryption key configured (the server variable {variable}). Ask the developer to set it; until then nothing can be saved here.
intg.secret.envNote: The value comes from the server variable {variable}. It is read-only here: it is changed on the server.
intg.secret.needsReentry: The server can no longer read this saved value (its encryption key was changed). Enter the key again.
intg.empty.title: No provider is installed
intg.empty.body: This shop has no email, payment or delivery service that needs a key.
intg.guide.title: How to get the key
intg.guide.resend.step2: In the Resend dashboard, add the domain you send from and publish the DNS records it shows.
intg.guide.resend.step3: In the dashboard, create an API key with sending access. Copy it right away and enter it here as the API key.
intg.guide.resend.webhookSecret: When you create a webhook in the Resend dashboard, it shows a signing secret that starts with whsec_. Enter that value here.
intg.guide.brevo.step2: In the Brevo dashboard, authenticate the domain you send from.
intg.guide.brevo.step3: Create an API key in the dashboard and enter it here. Use the API key, not the SMTP password.
intg.guide.brevo.webhookSecret: Brevo does not issue this value: you create it. Generate a long random token (at least 32 random bytes, only characters that are safe in a web address), put it into the webhook settings in Brevo and enter the same value here. Never reuse the API key for it.
intg.guide.monobank.step1: For a trial, get a test token on the Monobank API site.
intg.guide.monobank.step2: For real payments, create a token in the Monobank business cabinet.
intg.guide.nova_post.step1: Sign in to the Nova Post business cabinet.
intg.guide.nova_post.step2: Open Settings, then Security, and create an API key.
intg.dialog.enter.title: Enter the key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.enter.description: The key is stored encrypted and is never shown again. It stays off until it is activated.
intg.dialog.replace.title: Replace the saved key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.replace.description: The new key replaces the saved one. It is stored encrypted, is never shown again and stays off until it is activated.
intg.dialog.remove.title: Remove the saved key: {field}, {provider}
intg.dialog.remove.description: The saved value is deleted from the server. The services keep working with the keys set on the server.
intg.dialog.valueHint: Paste it exactly as the service shows it. Spaces around it are dropped.
intg.dialog.passwordHint: Asked for every change of a key.
intg.error.passwordIncorrect: The password is not correct. Nothing was changed.
intg.error.value.invalid_characters: The key contains a space or a character a key cannot have. Paste it again.
intg.error.value.invalid_format: This does not look like a key of this service. Check that you copied the right value.
intg.refusal.integration_storage_disable: The server has no encryption key configured, so nothing can be saved.
intg.refusal.integration_env_override: This value is set on the server and cannot be changed here.
intg.refusal.integration_revision_stale: The integrations were changed in the meantime. Nothing was changed: try again.
intg.refusal.integration_unavailable: This service's module could not be loaded on the server, so nothing was saved. Tell the developers.
intg.refusal.integration_version_not_ret: This saved value can no longer be removed. Reload the page to see the current state.
intg.refusal.step_up_unavailable: The password cannot be checked safely right now. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
intg.refusal.rateLimited: Too many password checks. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
intg.refusal.rateLimitedWait: Too many password checks. Nothing was changed. Try again in {minutes} min.
intg.notice.saved: The key is saved. It stays off until it is activated.
intg.notice.stale: The integrations were changed in the meantime. Nothing was changed and the list is reloaded: try again.
intg.notice.unknown: The server did not answer, so the change may or may not have happened. The list is reloaded: check the state before you repeat it.
